accepted_edits.reason: the edit makes exactly the two acted answers' changes to section 43's done-when

findings.reason: the one defect the gate exists to catch, a tick store that is not shared across duty items within one refresh, is invisible to it, so the measure must count the listing where it now happens or assert exactly one and the unchanged duty set.
findings.text: the head arm counts only `directory.glob`, which `_store_paths` never calls once `review_store_tick` is installed because `_tick_store` lists with `os.scandir` (verified: two `_store_paths` calls inside the tick record 0 globs), so "at most one listing per store per tick" is satisfied by zero and a refresh that installed a fresh tick per duty item would list the store 20 times through `os.scandir` and still pass

findings.reason: a control written as an equality fails at base for a reason unrelated to the defect, and a node reading that failure concludes the defect did not reproduce.
findings.text: the base arm is asserted to equal the number of duty items, but a cold index also lists the store to build it (verified: three `_store_index` calls on a fresh directory cost one glob), so the base count for the stated 20 duty items is 21 in a fresh process

response_events.note: §43 now counts every listing of the review store, through a recording stand-in for both directory.glob and os.scandir on that directory, and asserts at most one per store per tick.
§43's negative control now requires at least as many listings as duty items at base, not equality, since a cold index lists the store once more to build it.
